fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects commands that indicate a Raccine removal from an end system. Raccine is a free ransomware protection tool.
fields.name: Raccine Uninstall
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "taskkill " and tgt.process.cmdline contains "RaccineSettings.exe") or (tgt.process.cmdline contains "reg.exe" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "delete" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "Raccine Tray") or (tgt.process.cmdline contains "schtasks" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "/DELETE" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "Raccine Rules Updater")))
